text:
sam: Heads-up: scheduling a short maintenance to push a runtime kernel fix + apply a temporary model pin for EU & APAC. Prefer late-night windows. Need statuspage blurb + customer email.
maria: What exactly is the pin? full pin or traffic routing to compat variant?
sam: Temporary traffic pin to model=redwood-instruct-2.3.1-serve (no weight changes). We'll route new sessions to that variant for the window.
lucas: Suggest fallback target: redwood-instruct-2.2.9-serve. If we detect perf regressions, immediate revert to 2.2.9.
sam: Agreed. Canary -> pin -> monitor -> roll forward or rollback.
deploy-bot: Maintenance job 1767778888 scheduled. Canary on eu-west-1 at 23:45 UTC (5% traffic). Rollout plan: eu-* 00:05 UTC, ap-* 01:05 UTC staggered.
anya: I'll assemble statuspage and two email templates (customers + enterprise execs). Need tone and opt-out link.
support-olga: I'll compile VIP list and notify sales/SAMs for any customers with blackout windows. DM me any special-case tenants.
ops-ryan: Runbook addition: automated smoke tests include p50/p95, 5m error-rate, and token-throttle rate. Define thresholds now.
lucas: Thresholds: if p95 latency increases by >20% vs baseline OR error-rate >1% for 5m => initiate rollback.
maria: Also add a check for sustained token-throttling events (>3 consecutive minutes) -> alert oncall.
statusbot: Posting suggested statuspage content to #statuspage-drafts: 

[STATUS PAGE COPY]
Title: Planned maintenance 3 runtime kernel update & temporary model pin (EU & APAC)
Start times: EU window: 2026-03-23 23:45 UTC (canary), full EU rollout 2026-03-24 00:05 UTC. APAC rollout 2026-03-24 01:05 UTC.
Estimated per-region impact: ~10 minutes while instances warm caches.
Expected effect: brief request throttling and transient latency increase for a subset of traffic. Clients should retry on 429/503.
Customer action: none required. If you require a different maintenance window, please contact support@redwood.ai with "Maintenance Opt-Out" in subject.
Contact/status: status.redwood.ai | support@redwood.ai

Please flag legal/localization concerns.
sam: Email draft please. Keep it short and explicit about retry behavior.
anya: Customer email subject: "Planned maintenance: brief runtime update in your region"
Email body (customer): "We will perform a brief runtime kernel update in your region on the scheduled window. You may observe short request throttling while instances warm their caches (expected 10 minutes). No action is required on your part; clients should retry transient failures. If you'd like an alternate window, reply or contact support@redwood.ai."
Email body (enterprise execs): "We are scheduling a short maintenance to update runtime kernels and temporarily pin traffic to a compatible model variant to ensure stability. We expect minimal customer impact (brief throttling up to ~10 minutes per region). If this conflicts with your SLAs, reply to coordinate a different window."
support-olga: I'll attach an SMS alert option for enterprise contacts and include pager/phone table.
ops-ryan: Pin command we'll use internally: `rb pin --model redwood-instruct-2.3.1-serve --regions eu*,ap* --window '2026-03-23T23:40Z/2026-03-24T02:00Z' --reason 'kernel-fix-2026-03-23'`
Note: canary uses --traffic 5%.
lucas: Canary result gating: if canary p95 < baseline*1.2 AND error-rate < 1% -> promote. Otherwise abort and rollback.
sam: Add a human-in-loop for promotion. Deploy-bot can auto-promote but only after a manual ACK from oncall if canary metrics are within a grey zone (p95 between 1.1x-1.2x).
deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-23T23:45Z.
statusbot: Small wording note: avoid technical jargon in public status; replace 'KV cache' with 'instance cache warm-up' for customers.
maria: I'll update runbook excerpt and publish to #runbooks before the window.
anya: Localized email drafts uploaded to #support-drafts (FR, DE, JP) in ~20m.
support-olga: Pre-notify sent to top-10 enterprise accounts and product leads. SMS option enabled.
lucas: Rollback plan: 1) pin traffic back to redwood-instruct-2.2.9-serve 2) revoke new kernel on nodes failing smoke checks 3) scale up dedicated pools if needed 4) notify customers via status page with "Degraded performance" status. Aim to complete rollback within 20 minutes of decision.
sam: Post-maint checklist: collect perf deltas (p50/p95), error-rate timeline, throttling counts, and token-cost delta. Share summary in #eng-postmortems and to support for customer inquiries.
ops-ryan: I'll instrument an adhoc dashboard for tokens/sec and throttling events.
deploy-bot: Canary completed at 23:50 UTC. Metrics: p95 +8%, error-rate 0.4% -> passing. Proceeding with gradual EU rollout.
maria: If rollout triggers promo but any customer reports elevated errors, we'll flip status to "Degraded performance" immediately and consider rollback.
sam: Thank you all. Keep phone lines open for the next 3 hours. I'll update #eng-oncall with final links and the pin command. Closing thread unless someone raises blockers. :white_check_mark:
